title: Hypothesis: The Universe as an Energy-Driven System – Integrating Time, Space, Consciousness, and Thermodynamics
description: Proposes Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), a framework in which energy flow and the second law of thermodynamics govern the emergence and collapse of time, space, and consciousness. Introduces an entropy-scaled state variable S with boundaries at S=0 (singularity) and S=1 ("altular" maximum entropy), and outlines qualitative predictions for redshift behavior, time dilation, and consciousness thresholds.

entropy_bounds.description: Halo region: the observable universe exists between the singular (S=0) and altular (S=1) limits.

singularity_state.description: Singular boundary: maximal energy density, minimal entropy; time and space are locked/potential.

altular_state.description: Altular boundary: maximal entropy, minimal energy density; time-space collapses toward thermodynamic equilibrium.

second_law_global.description: Entropy in an isolated system does not decrease; EFC posits cosmic evolution is governed by increasing entropy.

key_results.main_finding: Time, space, and consciousness are emergent phenomena regulated by energy flow under an entropy-scaled state variable S, with qualitative predictions at S→0 and S→1.

sealed_predictions.statement: As regions approach S → 1 (altular limit), emitted light exhibits increasing redshift correlated with decreasing energy density and rising entropy.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Cross-correlating redshift maps with independent proxies of energy density/entropy gradients near the cosmic edge or low-density voids; absence of correlation would falsify.

sealed_predictions.statement: Near S → 0 (extreme energy density), time dilates toward a locked state.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: High-precision timing and spectroscopy of clocks and signals near compact-object horizons; failure to observe increasing time dilation toward higher energy density would falsify.

sealed_predictions.statement: Consciousness requires a minimum energy-flow threshold and ceases when energy throughput falls below this critical level.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Demonstration of sustained, verifiable conscious processing in systems with negligible or zero metabolic/energy throughput over relevant timescales.

kill_criteria: KC1: Empirical confirmation of persistent, stable time-space structure in regions demonstrated to be at maximal entropy (S ≈ 1) with no measurable energy gradients.
KC2: Robust, replicated evidence of conscious awareness persisting without measurable energy throughput (metabolic or equivalent) over relevant durations.
KC3: Cosmological observations indicating a net decrease of entropy over time in an effectively isolated cosmic volume.
KC4: No detectable correlation between increasing redshift and indicators of decreasing energy density/rising entropy at putative halo or edge regions when observational systematics are controlled.

KC5: Reliable observations that contradict gravitational/time-dilation growth toward higher energy density (e.g., near horizons), after accounting for general relativistic effects and measurement biases.
